Wide Tongue Sweep.name: Wide Tongue Sweep
Wide Tongue Sweep.description: The user extends their tongue to twenty meters and sweeps one opponent's legs, then coils around their torso before this turn ends. The fall deals heavy bludgeoning damage; held back, the user supports the descent and pins the arms without squeezing the chest. The user needs a firm anchor and cannot safely lift more than one adult; a trapped tongue leaves them exposed. Strain: severe.
